verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Grok models on Google Cloud Vertex AI and on Microsoft Foundry (Azure), with enterprise auth, monitoring, and unified billing. Community users independently report using Grok via OpenRouter, so it is reachable through a major router. Missing for 10: any evidence of Amazon Bedrock availability, first-party documentation of OpenRouter/gateway support, and confirmation of model and feature parity (e.g., grok-4.7) across the cloud listings.
